versos.grego: Ἀναβλέψας δὲ εἶδεν τοὺς βάλλοντας εἰς τὸ γαζοφυλάκιον τὰ δῶρα αὐτῶν πλουσίους.

controles.web: He looked up, and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.
controles.kjv: And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury.
controles.livre: E ele, olhando, viu os ricos lançarem suas ofertas na arca do tesouro do templo .

versos.grego: εἶδεν δέ τινα χήραν πενιχρὰν βάλλουσαν ἐκεῖ λεπτὰ δύο,

controles.web: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.
controles.kjv: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites.
controles.livre: E viu também uma pobre viúva lançar ali duas pequenas moedas.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν Ἀληθῶς λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἡ χήρα αὕτη ἡ πτωχὴ πλεῖον πάντων ἔβαλεν·

controles.web: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,
controles.kjv: And he said, Of a truth I say unto you, that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all:
controles.livre: E disse: Em verdade vos digo, que esta pobre viúva lançou mais do que todos,

versos.grego: πάντες γὰρ οὗτοι ἐκ τοῦ περισσεύοντος αὐτοῖς ἔβαλον εἰς τὰ δῶρα, αὕτη δὲ ἐκ τοῦ ὑστερήματος αὐτῆς πάντα τὸν βίον ὃν εἶχεν ἔβαλεν.

controles.web: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”
controles.kjv: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had.
controles.livre: Porque todos aqueles outros lançaram para as ofertas de Deus daquilo que lhes sobrava; mas esta viúva ,de sua pobreza, lançou todo sustento quanto tinha.

versos.grego: Καί τινων λεγόντων περὶ τοῦ ἱεροῦ, ὅτι λίθοις καλοῖς καὶ ἀναθήμασιν κεκόσμηται, εἶπεν

controles.web: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,
controles.kjv: And as some spake of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said,
controles.livre: E alguns estavam falando do Templo, que estava adornado com formosas pedras e ofertas. Então Jesus disse:

versos.grego: Ταῦτα ἃ θεωρεῖτε, ἐλεύσονται ἡμέραι ἐν αἷς οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται λίθος ἐπὶ λίθῳ ὃς οὐ καταλυθήσεται.

controles.web: “As for these things which you see, the days will come, in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”
controles.kjv: As for these things which ye behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
controles.livre: D estas coisas que vedes, dias virão, em que não se deixará pedra sobre pedra, que não seja derrubada.

versos.grego: ἐπηρώτησαν δὲ αὐτὸν λέγοντες Διδάσκαλε, πότε οὖν ταῦτα ἔσται, καὶ τί τὸ σημεῖον ὅταν μέλλῃ ταῦτα γίνεσθαι;

controles.web: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”
controles.kjv: And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass?
controles.livre: E perguntaram-lhe, dizendo: Mestre, quando então serão essas coisas? E que sinal haverá, quando essas coisas vierem a acontecer?

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Βλέπετε μὴ πλανηθῆτε· πολλοὶ γὰρ ἐλεύσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου λέγοντες Ἐγώ εἰμι, καί Ὁ καιρὸς ἤγγικεν· μὴ πορευθῆτε ὀπίσω αὐτῶν.

controles.web: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.
controles.kjv: And he said, Take heed that ye be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draweth near: go ye not therefore after them.
controles.livre: Então ele disse: Olhai para que não vos enganem, porque muitos virão em meu nome, dizendo: Eu sou o Cristo . E o tempo já está perto; portanto não os sigais.

versos.grego: ὅταν δὲ ἀκούσητε πολέμους καὶ ἀκαταστασίας, μὴ πτοηθῆτε· δεῖ γὰρ ταῦτα γενέσθαι πρῶτον, ἀλλ’ οὐκ εὐθέως τὸ τέλος.

controles.web: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”
controles.kjv: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by.
controles.livre: E quando ouvirdes de guerras, e de rebeliões, não vos espanteis. Porque é necessário que estas coisas aconteçam primeiro; mas ainda não é o fim.

versos.grego: Τότε ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ἐγερθήσεται ἔθνος ἐπ’ ἔθνος καὶ βασιλεία ἐπὶ βασιλείαν,

controles.web: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.
controles.kjv: Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom:
controles.livre: Então lhe disse: Então se levantará nação contra nação, e reino contra reino.

versos.grego: σεισμοί τε μεγάλοι καὶ κατὰ τόπους λοιμοὶ καὶ λιμοὶ ἔσονται, φόβητρά τε καὶ ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ σημεῖα μεγάλα ἔσται.

controles.web: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
controles.kjv: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven.
controles.livre: E haverá em vários lugares grandes terremotos e fomes, e pragas; haverá também coisas espantosas, e grandes sinais do céu.

versos.grego: πρὸ δὲ τούτων πάντων ἐπιβαλοῦσιν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ διώξουσιν, παραδιδόντες εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς καὶ φυλακάς, ἀπαγομένους ἐπὶ βασιλεῖς καὶ ἡγεμόνας ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός μου·

controles.web: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
controles.kjv: But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name’s sake.
controles.livre: Mas antes de tudo isto, eles vos impedirão e vos perseguirão, vos entregando em sinagogas e prisões, e vos trazendo diante de reis, e governadores, por causa do meu nome.

versos.grego: ἀποβήσεται ὑμῖν εἰς μαρτύριον.

controles.web: It will turn out as a testimony for you.
controles.kjv: And it shall turn to you for a testimony.
controles.livre: E isto vos acontecerá para haver testemunho.

versos.grego: θέτε οὖν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν μὴ προμελετᾶν ἀπολογηθῆναι·

controles.web: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,
controles.kjv: Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what ye shall answer:
controles.livre: Ponde, então, em vossos corações, de que não planejeis como direis em vossa defesa,

versos.grego: ἐγὼ γὰρ δώσω ὑμῖν στόμα καὶ σοφίαν, ᾗ οὐ δυνήσονται ἀντιστῆναι ἢ ἀντειπεῖν ἅπαντες οἱ ἀντικείμενοι ὑμῖν.

controles.web: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.
controles.kjv: For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist.
controles.livre: Porque eu vos darei boca e sabedoria, para que todos os que forem contra vós não posam vos contradizer ou resistir.

versos.grego: παραδοθήσεσθε δὲ καὶ ὑπὸ γονέων καὶ ἀδελφῶν καὶ συγγενῶν καὶ φίλων, καὶ θανατώσουσιν ἐξ ὑμῶν,

controles.web: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.
controles.kjv: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death.
controles.livre: E vós sereis entregues até pelos pais, e irmãos, e parentes, e amigos; e alguns de vós serão mortos.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔσεσθε μισούμενοι ὑπὸ πάντων διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου.

controles.web: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.
controles.kjv: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.
controles.livre: E vós sereis odiados por todos por causa do meu nome.

versos.grego: καὶ θρὶξ ἐκ τῆς κεφαλῆς ὑμῶν οὐ μὴ ἀπόληται·

controles.web: And not a hair of your head will perish.
controles.kjv: But there shall not an hair of your head perish.
controles.livre: Mas nem um cabelo de vossa cabeça parecerá.

versos.grego: ἐν τῇ ὑπομονῇ ὑμῶν κτήσεσθε τὰς ψυχὰς ὑμῶν.

controles.web: “By your endurance you will win your lives.
controles.kjv: In your patience possess ye your souls.
controles.livre: Por vossa paciência ganhareis vossas almas.

versos.grego: Ὅταν δὲ ἴδητε κυκλουμένην ὑπὸ στρατοπέδων Ἱερουσαλήμ, τότε γνῶτε ὅτι ἤγγικεν ἡ ἐρήμωσις αὐτῆς.

controles.web: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.
controles.kjv: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh.
controles.livre: Porém quando virdes a Jerusalém cercada de exércitos, sabei então, que próxima está sua desolação.

versos.grego: τότε οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ φευγέτωσαν εἰς τὰ ὄρη, καὶ οἱ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς ἐκχωρείτωσαν, καὶ οἱ ἐν ταῖς χώραις μὴ εἰσερχέσθωσαν εἰς αὐτήν,

controles.web: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the midst of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.
controles.kjv: Then let them which are in Judea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter thereinto.
controles.livre: Então, os que estiverem na Judeia, fujam para os montes; e os que estiverem no meio dela, saiam, e os que estiverem nos campos, não entrem nela.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἡμέραι ἐκδικήσεως αὗταί εἰσιν τοῦ πλησθῆναι πάντα τὰ γεγραμμένα.

controles.web: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
controles.kjv: For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.
controles.livre: Porque estes são dias de vingança, para que todas as coisas que estão escritas se cumpram.

versos.grego: οὐαὶ ταῖς ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσαις καὶ ταῖς θηλαζούσαις ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις· ἔσται γὰρ ἀνάγκη μεγάλη ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὀργὴ τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ,

controles.web: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land, and wrath to this people.
controles.kjv: But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people.
controles.livre: Mas ai das grávidas, e das que amamentarem naqueles dias; porque grande calamidade haverá na terra, e ira contra este povo.

versos.grego: καὶ πεσοῦνται στόματι μαχαίρης καὶ αἰχμαλωτισθήσονται εἰς τὰ ἔθνη πάντα, καὶ Ἱερουσαλὴμ ἔσται πατουμένη ὑπὸ ἐθνῶν, ἄχρι οὗ πληρωθῶσιν καιροὶ ἐθνῶν.

controles.web: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.
controles.kjv: And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.
controles.livre: E cairão pela lâmina de espada, e serão levados cativos para todas as nações; e Jerusalém será pisada pelos gentios, até que os tempos dos gentios se cumpram.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἔσονται σημεῖα ἐν ἡλίῳ καὶ σελήνῃ καὶ ἄστροις, καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς συνοχὴ ἐθνῶν ἐν ἀπορίᾳ ἤχους θαλάσσης καὶ σάλου,

controles.web: There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;
controles.kjv: And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring;
controles.livre: E haverá sinais no Sol, na Lua, e nas estrelas; e na terra sofrimento entre as nações, como o rugir e agitar do mar.

versos.grego: ἀποψυχόντων ἀνθρώπων ἀπὸ φόβου καὶ προσδοκίας τῶν ἐπερχομένων τῇ οἰκουμένῃ· αἱ γὰρ δυνάμεις τῶν οὐρανῶν σαλευθήσονται.

controles.web: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.
controles.kjv: Men’s hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken.
controles.livre: As pessoas se enfraquecendo de medo, e da espera das coisas que virão ao mundo, porque os poderes dos céus serão abalados.

versos.grego: καὶ τότε ὄψονται τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐρχόμενον ἐν νεφέλῃ μετὰ δυνάμεως καὶ δόξης πολλῆς.

controles.web: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
controles.kjv: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.
controles.livre: E então verão o Filho do homem vir em uma nuvem com grande poder e glória.

versos.grego: ἀρχομένων δὲ τούτων γίνεσθαι ἀνακύψατε καὶ ἐπάρατε τὰς κεφαλὰς ὑμῶν, διότι ἐγγίζει ἡ ἀπολύτρωσις ὑμῶν.

controles.web: But when these things begin to happen, look up, and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”
controles.kjv: And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draweth nigh.
controles.livre: Ora, quando estas coisas começarem a acontecer, olhai para cima, e levantai vossas cabeças, porque vosso resgate está perto.

versos.grego: Καὶ εἶπεν παραβολὴν αὐτοῖς Ἴδετε τὴν συκῆν καὶ πάντα τὰ δένδρα·

controles.web: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree, and all the trees.
controles.kjv: And he spake to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees;
controles.livre: E disse-lhes uma parábola: Olhai a figueira, e todas as árvores;

versos.grego: ὅταν προβάλωσιν ἤδη, βλέποντες ἀφ’ ἑαυτῶν γινώσκετε ὅτι ἤδη ἐγγὺς τὸ θέρος ἐστίν·

controles.web: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.
controles.kjv: When they now shoot forth, ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand.
controles.livre: Quando vós vedes elas já brotando, sabeis por vós mesmos que o verão já está perto.

versos.grego: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς, ὅταν ἴδητε ταῦτα γινόμενα, γινώσκετε ὅτι ἐγγύς ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that the Kingdom of God is near.
controles.kjv: So likewise ye, when ye see these things come to pass, know ye that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand.
controles.livre: Assim também vós, quando virdes acontecer estas coisas, sabei que o Reino de Deus já está perto.

versos.grego: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ παρέλθῃ ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη ἕως ἂν πάντα γένηται.

controles.web: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.
controles.kjv: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled.
controles.livre: Em verdade vos digo, que esta geração não passará, até que tudo aconteça.

versos.grego: ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ παρελεύσονται, οἱ δὲ λόγοι μου οὐ μὴ παρελεύσονται.

controles.web: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.
controles.kjv: Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words shall not pass away.
controles.livre: O céu e a terra passarão, mas minhas palavras de maneira nenhuma passarão.

versos.grego: Προσέχετε δὲ ἑαυτοῖς μή ποτε βαρηθῶσιν ὑμῶν αἱ καρδίαι ἐν κραιπάλῃ καὶ μέθῃ καὶ μερίμναις βιωτικαῖς, καὶ ἐπιστῇ ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς αἰφνίδιος ἡ ἡμέρα ἐκείνη

controles.web: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.
controles.kjv: And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unawares.
controles.livre: E olhai por vós, para que vossos corações não venham a se encher de ressaca e embriaguez, e das preocupações d esta vida; e vos venha aquele dia de surpresa.

versos.grego: ὡς παγίς· ἐπεισελεύσεται γὰρ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς καθημένους ἐπὶ πρόσωπον πάσης τῆς γῆς.

controles.web: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.
controles.kjv: For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth.
controles.livre: Porque virá como uma armadilha sobre todos os que habitam sobre a face de toda a terra.

versos.grego: ἀγρυπνεῖτε δὲ ἐν παντὶ καιρῷ δεόμενοι ἵνα κατισχύσητε ἐκφυγεῖν ταῦτα πάντα τὰ μέλλοντα γίνεσθαι, καὶ σταθῆναι ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου.

controles.web: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”
controles.kjv: Watch ye therefore, and pray always, that ye may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man.
controles.livre: Então vigiai sempre, orando para que sejais considerados dignos de escaparem de todas as coisas que irão acontecer, e de ficarem de pé diante do Filho do homem.

versos.grego: Ἦν δὲ τὰς ἡμέρας ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ διδάσκων, τὰς δὲ νύκτας ἐξερχόμενος ηὐλίζετο εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ καλούμενον Ἐλαιῶν.

controles.web: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.
controles.kjv: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives.
controles.livre: E ensinava durante os dias no Templo, porém, às noites saía e as passava no monte, chamado as Oliveiras.

versos.grego: καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὤρθριζεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἀκούειν αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.
controles.kjv: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, for to hear him.
controles.livre: E todo o povo vinha até ele de manhã cedo ao templo, para o ouvir.
